Floating position: starting from the first watermark position, the other watermarks are added clockwise
Fixed single position: the watermarks are shown in a row at the given position

When a scrape succeeds, a video directory is created for that video and moved to the success output directory.
The naming template uses standard Jinja2 syntax: a field is written {{ field name }} and a condition {% if field name %}...{% endif %}.
Example: {{ number }}{% if studio %} [{{ studio }}]{% endif %} {{ originaltitle }} {{ definition }}
Symbols in the template are not removed when a field is empty; wrap a whole section in a Jinja2 if to avoid empty [] or stray separators.
Common fields: {{ number }} code, {{ title }} title, {{ originaltitle }} original title, {{ actor }} actors, {{ studio }} studio, {{ series }} series, {{ release }} release date, {{ definition }} definition, {{ filename }} original filename.
Other fields: all_actor (all actors), first_actor (first actor), letters (code prefix), first_letter (first character of the code), outline (plot), director, publisher, year, runtime, mosaic (censored/uncensored), cnword (subtitle marker), moword (version marker), wanted (wanted count), score, four_k (4K/8K/UHD marker).
Notes:
1. A / in the template creates a subdirectory; a / inside a field value is turned into -; Jinja2 only produces text;
2. An empty video directory name means no video directory is created;
3. When the name is too long, long fields such as plot and title are shortened first and key fields such as the code are kept.

Actors for amateur and FC2 codes may be fake names such as 「素人」. Ticking "Use AV-wiki to get actors' real names" asks AV-wiki for the actor's real Japanese name, which can then be translated with the mapping table!
Actor names are complicated and cannot simply be run through a translation engine. The main problems: inaccurate translation, several names per actor, inconsistent actor names for the same actor across codes, different sites using different names.
An actor-name mapping table solves these and keeps scraped actor names consistent.
How it works: after a scraped site returns the actor name, the matching keyword in the mapping table is looked up to map it to an output word.
The actor-name mapping table file is: mapping_actor.xml
· Windows path: \config dir\userdata\mapping_actor.xml (the config directory is set in [Settings] - [Other])
· Mac path: /config dir/userdata/mapping_actor.xml
You can open the file in a text editor and edit it yourself. The fields in the mapping table mean:
1. keyword: the match word (a comma before and after each name). After a site returns an actor name it is matched against the keyword names.
2. zh_cn/zh_tw/jp: the output words. When a keyword matches an actor name, the name in the matching language is output.

刮削结束后，不删除空文件夹: Do not delete empty folders when scraping finishes
刮削结束后，删除刮削目录中的所有空文件夹: Delete every empty folder in the scrape directory when scraping finishes
勾选后将同时复制网盘中刮削好的nfo等文件到本地，或者你也可以重新刮削这些软链接: When checked, the files already scraped on the cloud drive (nfo and so on) are copied locally as well; you can also re-scrape these symlinks
勾选后将检查软链接文件指向的目标文件是否存在，若不存在则会删除该软链接: When checked, verifies that the file each symlink points to still exists; if not, the symlink is deleted
勾选后，-C、.C将识别为CD3，不再识别为字幕: When checked, -C and .C are read as CD3 and no longer as subtitles
单文件刮削（指定某个文件的番号网址进行刮削，当存在相同番号时可用这个）: Single-file scrape (scrape one file by giving that code's web page; use this when the same code exists more than once)
去除标题后的演员名（个别网站在标题末尾额外多加了演员名，建议去除）: Strip the actor name appended to the title (some sites add the actor name at the end of the title; removing it is recommended)

去除素人番号前缀数字（比如：259LUXU-1488 将修改为 LUXU-148: Strip the numeric prefix from amateur codes (e.g. 259LUXU-1488 becomes LUXU-1488; keeping it is recommended)

One or more video directories; separate multiple directories with ; or ；.

同时复制网盘目录的nfo、图片、字幕文件到软链接目录: Also copy the nfo, image and subtitle files from the cloud drive directory into the symlink directory

启用 Amazon 查找高清封面图: Use Amazon to find high-resolution cover images
国产封面不裁剪，直接复制缩略图: Do not crop Chinese domestic covers, copy the thumbnail as is
图片下载失败时，不视为刮削失败: An image download failure is not treated as a scrape failure
在以下目录为待刮削目录中的视频创建软链接，然后刮削以下目录（适合网盘用户）: Create symlinks for the videos of the scrape directory in the directory below, then scrape that directory (for cloud drive users)

在视频目录创建「trailers」文件夹，多分集共用一个「trailer.mp4: Create a "trailers" folder in the video directory; multi-part videos share one "trailer.mp4"
如果设置，将仅获取指定 Emby/Jellyfin 用户媒体库中的演员: When set, only the actors in the given Emby/Jellyfin user's library are fetched
字幕文件名添加.chs后缀: Add the .chs suffix to subtitle filenames
字段优先图片下载失败时，继续尝试其它图片候选: When a fields-first image download fails, keep trying the other image candidates
对所有 Amazon 结果做图片相似度校验: Compare every Amazon result by image similarity
将为待刮削目录的每个视频在同目录创建一个 .actors 文件夹，并将该视频的演: Creates an .actors folder next to every video in the scrape directory and puts that video's actor images in it

将优先使用刮削网站的中文翻译，当刮削页面无中文时，才使用以下翻译方式。: The Chinese translation from the scraped site is preferred; the methods below are used only when the scraped page has no Chinese.
将读取该目录中的配置文件、映射表、水印图片、演员头像等数据，修改后重启程序方可生: Reads the config files, mapping tables, watermark images, actor headshots and other data in this directory; changes take effect after restarting the program
年: YYYY或YY，月: MM，日:DD，比如: YY.MM.DD 将显示为: year: YYYY or YY, month: MM, day: DD; e.g. YY.MM.DD renders as 22.03.20
建议 Fork 该项目到你的 Github，当项目故障时，可填写你 Fork 后: Forking that project to your own GitHub is recommended; if it breaks you can enter the address of your fork
当勾选多个时，将随机使用所勾选的其中任一翻译引擎，可降低被封几率: When several are ticked, one of the ticked engines is picked at random, which lowers the chance of being blocked
当字段语言选择中文，但只刮削到日语时，可使用翻译引擎进行翻译: When the field language is set to Chinese but only Japanese was scraped, a translation engine can translate it
当指定网站时，所有番号将只使用该网站刮削！: With a specific site, every code is scraped from that site only!
当有失败任务时，点击可以一键刮削当前失败列表: When tasks have failed, click to re-scrape the whole failed list in one go
当演员名不存在时，在使用演员命名字段命名时，使用以上字符替代: When no actor name exists, these characters are used in place of the actor naming field
忽略包含特定字符串的文件: Ignore files containing a given string
我已同意：无论出现任何问题，均与开发者无关，后果自行承担。: I agree: whatever happens, the developer is not responsible and I bear the consequences.
我已知晓：文件删除后无法恢复！操作须谨慎！: I understand: deleted files cannot be recovered! Handle with care!
执行：刮削->下载封面->重命名->水印等全部操作，适合要海报墙的情况: Runs everything: scrape -> download cover -> rename -> watermark. Good when you want a poster wall
执行：刮削->重命名，仅整理本地视频，不下载图片，适合不要海报墙的情况: Runs: scrape -> rename; only organises local videos and downloads no images. Good when you do not want a poster wall
指不想要刮削的目录，可以填写多个目录，以逗号分开（中英文逗号都可以）: Directories you do not want to scrape. Several directories can be listed, separated by commas (full-width or half-width commas both work)
指你的 Emby/Jellyfin 服务器地址，比如：http://192.16: Your Emby/Jellyfin server address, e.g. http://192.168.1.5:8096
指刮削失败时，视频将移动到这个文件夹。输出目录可以不在待刮削视频目录下: When a scrape fails, the video is moved to this folder. The output directory does not have to be inside the scrape directory
指刮削成功时，视频将移动到这个文件夹。输出目录可以不在待刮削视频目录下: When a scrape succeeds, the video is moved to this folder. The output directory does not have to be inside the scrape directory
指命名时在番号后添加 4K（仅4K）。你也可以使用 4K 字段来调整添加位置: Adds 4K after the code when naming (4K only). You can also use the 4K field to control where it is added
指命名时在番号后添加中文字幕命名字符。你也可以使用 cnword 字段来调整添加: Adds the Chinese subtitle naming character after the code. You can also use the cnword field to control where it is added
指命名时在番号后添加版本命名字符。你也可以使用 moword 字段来调整添加位置: Adds a version marker after the code when naming. You can also use the moword field to control where it is added
指在 nfo 文件中的标题(title)格式，在 Emby 中作为视频标题显示，: The title format written into the nfo file; it is shown as the video title in Emby. Full Jinja2 syntax is supported
指有多位演员时，命名时最多显示的演员数量。超出的演员将用以下字符替代：: When several actors are credited, the maximum number shown in the name. Extra actors are replaced with the characters below:
指本地视频文件的文件名格式，命名字段同上，推荐 {{ number }}: The filename format for local video files; the naming fields are the same as above, {{ number }} is recommended
指视频有中文字幕时，在重命名文件名及目录名时在番号后添加该字符表示有中文字幕: When a video has Chinese subtitles this character is added after the code in file and directory names to mark it
按各个字段设置的刮削网站进行刮削，字段来自多个网站。字段全一些。: Scrapes with the site set for each field; the fields come from several sites. More complete fields.
按番号类型设置的刮削网站进行刮削，字段来自单个网站。速度快一些。: Scrapes with the sites set for the code type; the fields come from a single site. A bit faster.
提示词模板. 可用变量: {content} 原文 {lang} 目标语言: Prompt template. Available variables: {content} source text, {lang} target language
支持记录和跳过已刮削成功的文件，避免新增视频时重复刮削之前成功的文件: Records and skips files that were already scraped successfully, so adding new videos does not re-scrape the old ones
新添加字幕的视频在结束后重新刮削: Re-scrape videos that received a new subtitle when finished
无NFO时刮削: Scrape when there is no NFO
无码封面不裁剪，直接复制缩略图: Do not crop uncensored covers, copy the thumbnail as is
映射表文件名：mapping_info.xml。作用和演员映射表类似，说明可参考: Mapping table filename: mapping_info.xml. It works like the actor mapping table; see the actor mapping table for an explanation.

更新视频所在目录及该目录下的内容，即：../A/B[NEW]/C[NEW].mp: Update the video's directory and the contents of that directory, i.e. ../A/B[NEW]/C[NEW].mp4
有码 Poster 竖图按大小自动选优: For censored poster (portrait) images, pick the best automatically by size
有码封面不裁剪，直接复制缩略图: Do not crop censored covers, copy the thumbnail as is
本地之前刮削失败的文件和没有nfo的文件，重新刮削（按更新模式规则）: Re-scrape files that failed before and files without an nfo (following the update mode rules)
本地已刮削成功的文件，重新整理分类（按更新模式规则）: Re-organise files that were already scraped successfully locally (following the update mode rules)
本地目录中的软链接文件位置将同步按照网盘的文件目录结构创建: Symlinks are created in the local directory following the cloud drive's folder structure
本地资源库和演员名都可以填写多个，以逗号分开（中英文逗号都可以）: Both the local library and the actor name accept several values, separated by commas (full-width or half-width commas both work)
标题末尾写入分集信息: Write part information at the end of the title
根据你使用的 API 提供商的限制设定: Set it according to the limits of the API provider you use
检查并清理失效的软链接: Check and clean up broken symlinks
检查演员缺失番号（检查资源库中指定演员本地缺失的番号）: Check missing codes for an actor (list the codes a given actor is missing locally)
欧美封面不裁剪，直接复制缩略图: Do not crop western covers, copy the thumbnail as is
此工具支持拖动选择裁剪范围，可将图片裁剪为封面图（poster）。: This tool supports drag-selecting the crop area; crop the image to a cover (poster).
每个视频创建一个「视频名-trailer.mp4」，多分集时会创建多个: One "video name-trailer.mp4" per video; several are created for multi-part videos
比如：MIDE-111，以及不符合以下类型的番号: Example: MIDE-111, and any code not matching the types below

水印规则为固定时的位置: Watermark position when the placement rule is fixed
注意：如果需要繁体，请到「设置」-「翻译」-「标签」，勾选为繁体！: Note: for traditional Chinese go to [Settings] - [Translate] - [Tags] and tick traditional!

注：软硬链接不会移动和重命名原视频文件，仅移动和重命名链接文件: Note: symlinks and hardlinks do not move or rename the original video file; only the link file is moved and renamed
流程同正常模式，但命名按照更新模式规则执行（在下方设置），适合二次刮削: Same flow as normal mode, but naming follows the update mode rules (set below). Good for a second pass
清理包含特定字符串的文件: Clean files containing a given string

目录中的文件较多时，可以勾选此项以提高打开速度: Tick this when a directory holds many files, to open it faster

若启用则使用首个来源的数据并翻译为指定语言; 否则使用第一个指定语言的数据, 如: If enabled, use the first source's data and translate it into the chosen language; otherwise use the first source that already has data in that language, and treat the field as failed if none do.
获取软链接指向的原文件的分辨率: Read the resolution of the file a symlink points to
补全完成后自动补全演员头像: Complete actor headshots automatically when this finishes

视频目录设置：【设置】-【目录】-【待刮削视频目录】。程序将刮削该目录及子目录的: Video directory: set it in [Settings] - [Directories] - [Video directory to scrape]. Every file in that directory and its subdirectories is scraped.
记住未完成的刮削任务，即使退出或中止，下次仍可继续刮削未完成任务: Remembers unfinished scrape tasks, so they can be resumed next time even after exiting or stopping
记录刮削成功的文件列表: Record the list of successfully scraped files
设置 javdb 延时可降低 javdb 被封概率，将在1/2延时-1延时之间随: A javdb delay lowers the chance of being blocked by javdb; a random value between delay/2 and delay is used.
